text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience working with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, and Stripe.

I’m interested in your full-time role building high-traffic, real-time web products. I’ve worked on an end-to-end test suite for Kestrel Insurance, where I built browser tests for the broker quoting flow that run on every pull request. That suite included 160 tests and helped reduce release regressions from 6 per quarter to 1.

I’m comfortable across front end and back end work, and I’d be glad to contribute to maintaining and improving reliable web properties at scale.
